coords: three.js world metres (X east, Y up, Z south). Add the GLB at the origin with no transform; every node carries only a translation (its pivot).

nodes.pivot: mesh-less pivot node (survives quantization); geometry in child RowingBoat_Geo

notes.RowingBoat: Clinker-built rowing boat (3.9 m, thwarts, ribs, floorboards, rowlocks, two shipped oars, coiled painter). Mesh-less pivot node at the waterline centre (y = pond surface 0.087), bow toward +X (the open boat door); geometry in child RowingBoat_Geo. Bob it about this origin: keep heave within about +/-3 cm and roll/pitch within about 2 deg (the stern keel clears the pond bed by about 7 cm).
notes.Boathouse: Tarred lapped weatherboard (geometry laps aligned to the texture rows) on an oak frame, steep plain-tile roof with lapped courses, ridge tiles, bargeboards. Open boat door at the east (pond) end, side door + 4-pane window (Window_Glass) on the south wall. Pivot = (-44.5, 0.35, -37).
notes.floors: Walkways either side of the wet dock and the landing stage deck at y 0.35. Over the land half (x < -45.0) a raised store floor at y 0.97 on brick sill walls covers the bank, so terrain (<= 0.85 there) never shows through. Wet dock x -45.0..-40, z -38.75..-35.25 is open water.
notes.LandingStage: Timber stage along the south wall, x -47.5..-38.3, z -34.24..-32.7, deck y 0.36, oak piles driven 0.6 m into the bed, mooring post with ring + rope, sleeper steps up the bank at the west end.
notes.groundContact: Piles end 0.6 m below the sampled bed; brick sill walls 0.4 m below the lowest ground on the land segments.
notes.materials: M_OakWet / M_BoatPaint / M_Varnish reuse the M_Oak images with baseColorFactor tints.

channels.r: baked ambient occlusion (Cycles, incl. terrain contact)

vertexColors.warning: GLTFLoader sets material.vertexColors = true when COLOR_0 exists, which would tint by the masks. Set it false and read the attribute as data (same convention as mill.glb).
